intent: Equal 10-day essay periods instead of uneven weeks; derive exclusion_category from the computed window; add enrichment invariant, binomial and cadence reference tests from mutation survivors

edits.new_content:
{#- Every enrichment here is derived from the research CSV itself, the mapping seeds,
    or METHODOLOGY.md; nothing comes from new research. -#}

with

candidates as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_research__release_candidates') }}

),

release_types as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_release_type_map') }}

),

tiers as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_tier_map') }}

),

labs as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_labs') }}

),

source_domains as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_source_domains') }}

),

date_sensitivity as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_date_sensitivity') }}

),

joined as (

    select
        candidates.*,
        release_types.access_level,
        release_types.open_weights_status,
        release_types.has_gated_variant,
        release_types.is_snapshot_update,
        release_types.is_staggered_rollout,
        coalesce(tiers.tier_band, 'not_classified') as tier_band,
        tiers.tier_rank,
        not labs.in_scope_list as is_borderline_lab,
        source_domains.source_type,
        source_domains.source_rank,
        date_sensitivity.conflicting_date

    from candidates
    left join release_types
        on candidates.release_type = release_types.release_type
    left join tiers
        on candidates.tier = tiers.tier
    left join labs
        on candidates.lab_id = labs.lab_id
    left join source_domains
        on candidates.source_domain = source_domains.source_domain
    left join date_sensitivity
        on candidates.model_name = date_sensitivity.model_name

),

timed as (

    select
        *,
        release_date - date '{{ var("essay_date") }}' as days_from_essay,
        coalesce(conflicting_date, release_date) as alt_release_date,
        coalesce(conflicting_date, release_date) - date '{{ var("essay_date") }}' as days_from_essay_alt_date

    from joined

),

classified as (

    select
        *,
        {{ essay_window('days_from_essay') }} as essay_window,
        {{ essay_window('days_from_essay_alt_date') }} as essay_window_alt_date,
        -- Equal 10-day periods, three per window: +1 = days 1..10 after, -3 = days 21..30 before.
        -- Rows outside the windows land in periods beyond +/-3.
        cast(sign(days_from_essay) * ceil(abs(days_from_essay) / 10.0) as integer) as essay_period,
        dayname(release_date) as release_weekday,
        isodow(release_date) in (6, 7) as is_weekend,
        conflicting_date is not null as has_date_conflict,
        access_level = 'general_availability' as is_generally_available,
        access_level in ('preview_or_limited', 'gated_or_restricted', 'announced_only') as is_restricted_access,
        access_level = 'announced_only' as is_announced_only,
        open_weights_status in ('at_launch', 'promised_later') as is_open_weights,
        case
            when is_top_tier and is_snapshot_update then 'flagship_refresh'
            when is_top_tier then 'new_flagship'
            when not is_top_tier then 'below_flagship'
            else 'not_assessed'
        end as top_tier_kind,
        case
            when notes ilike '%DevDay%' then 'OpenAI DevDay'
            when notes ilike '%Apsara%' then 'Alibaba Apsara Conference'
        end as launch_event

    from timed

),

final as (

    select
        *,
        case
            when essay_period < 0
                then (-essay_period * 10 - 9) || '-' || (-essay_period * 10) || ' days before'
            when essay_period > 0
                then (essay_period * 10 - 9) || '-' || (essay_period * 10) || ' days after'
            else 'essay day'
        end as essay_period_label,
        case
            when is_counted then null
            when notes ilike '%outside the 13-lab list%' then 'lab_outside_list'
            when essay_window = 'outside' then 'outside_window'
            when notes ilike '%earnings call%' then 'roadmap_mention'
            when notes ilike '%never announced%' or access_level = 'cancelled' then 'never_released'
            when notes ilike '%decision-only%' then 'decision_only_endpoint'
            when notes ilike '%configuration%' then 'product_configuration'
            when notes ilike '%serving%' or notes ilike '%pricing%' then 'serving_or_pricing_tier'
            when regexp_matches(lower(notes), 'image|video|speech|voice|avatar|translation') then 'non_llm_modality'
            else 'unclassified'
        end as exclusion_category,
        essay_window is distinct from essay_window_alt_date as is_window_date_sensitive,
        -- METHODOLOGY 7.2 variants of the counting rule.
        is_counted and not is_announced_only as is_counted_released_only,
        is_counted or (is_borderline_lab and essay_window in ('before', 'after')) as is_counted_incl_borderline

    from classified

)

select * from final

{#- One row per candidate release, counted or not, so that exclusions and every
    sensitivity variant stay queryable. Filter on is_counted for the main definition. -#}

with

enriched as (

    select * from {{ ref('int_release_candidates__enriched') }}

),

final as (

    select
        -- keys
        release_id,
        lab_id,

        -- what was released
        model_name,
        developer_name,
        tier,
        tier_band,
        tier_rank,
        is_top_tier,
        top_tier_kind,
        release_type,
        access_level,
        is_generally_available,
        is_restricted_access,
        is_announced_only,
        has_gated_variant,
        open_weights_status,
        is_open_weights,
        is_snapshot_update,
        is_staggered_rollout,
        launch_event,

        -- when, relative to the essay
        release_date,
        days_from_essay,
        essay_window,
        essay_period,
        essay_period_label,
        release_weekday,
        is_weekend,

        -- counting rule and its variants
        is_counted,
        exclusion_category,
        is_borderline_lab,
        is_counted_released_only,
        is_counted_incl_borderline,

        -- date sensitivity (METHODOLOGY 7.1)
        has_date_conflict,
        alt_release_date,
        days_from_essay_alt_date,
        essay_window_alt_date,
        is_window_date_sensitive,

        -- evidence
        source_url,
        source_domain,
        source_type,
        source_rank,
        notes

    from enriched

)

select * from final

version: 2

models:
  - name: dim_labs
    description: >
      One row per lab in the research (13 on the agreed list, 4 borderline), with its
      geography and its recorded public stance on the essay. See seed_labs for sourcing.
    columns:
      - name: lab_id
        description: Lab key (slug of the lab name).
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_name
        description: Lab name as written in the research.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: in_scope_list
        description: True for the 13 labs on the agreed list.
      - name: lab_scope
        description: agreed_13_lab_list or borderline.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [agreed_13_lab_list, borderline]
      - name: parent_country
        description: Country of the parent company.
      - name: region
        description: US, China, Europe or Japan.
      - name: essay_coordination_group
        description: us_frontier_company, other_democracy or china (see seed_labs).
      - name: essay_stance
        description: author, endorsed_publicly or none_recorded.
      - name: is_author_or_endorser
        description: True for Anthropic (author), OpenAI and xAI (public endorsements on 12 Sep 2026).
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: stance_date
        description: Date of the recorded public stance.
      - name: stance_quote
        description: Verbatim public statement.
      - name: stance_source_url
        description: Source of the stance.

  - name: fct_release_candidates
    description: >
      One row per candidate release (52), counted or not. The main definition is
      `is_counted`; `is_counted_released_only`, `is_counted_incl_borderline` and
      `essay_window_alt_date` reproduce the METHODOLOGY 7.2 variants.
    columns:
      - name: release_id
        description: Surrogate key, slugify(developer) || '__' || slugify(model).
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_id
        description: Lab key.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_labs')
                field: lab_id
      - name: model_name
        description: Model name as written in the research; combined names are one counted unit.
      - name: developer_name
        description: Lab name as written in the research.
      - name: tier
        description: Position in the developer's lineup as written in the research.
      - name: tier_band
        description: flagship, upper, mid, small_fast or not_classified (no tier recorded).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [flagship, upper, mid, small_fast, not_classified]
      - name: tier_rank
        description: 1 flagship, 2 upper, 3 mid, 4 small or fast.
      - name: is_top_tier
        description: The researcher's top_tier flag (METHODOLOGY 4.6). Null on excluded rows.
      - name: top_tier_kind
        description: >
          new_flagship (top tier, not a snapshot), flagship_refresh (top tier and a point or
          snapshot update of an existing flagship), below_flagship, or not_assessed (excluded rows).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [new_flagship, flagship_refresh, below_flagship, not_assessed]
      - name: release_type
        description: Release type as written in the research.
      - name: access_level
        description: Normalized access on the counted date (see seed_release_type_map).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [general_availability, preview_or_limited, gated_or_restricted, announced_only, cancelled, non_release]
      - name: is_generally_available
        description: access_level = general_availability.
      - name: is_restricted_access
        description: Preview or limited, gated or restricted, or announced only.
      - name: is_announced_only
        description: Announced, not released (Qwen4).
      - name: has_gated_variant
        description: The same model also shipped at a restricted access level.
      - name: open_weights_status
        description: at_launch, promised_later or none.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [at_launch, promised_later, none]
      - name: is_open_weights
        description: Weights released at launch or promised for later.
      - name: is_snapshot_update
        description: Point release or snapshot update of an existing model.
      - name: is_staggered_rollout
        description: Wider access or weights announced for later dates.
      - name: launch_event
        description: Event the release was tied to, when the research notes name one.
      - name: release_date
        description: Announcement date (METHODOLOGY 4.5).
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: days_from_essay
        description: release_date minus the essay date (12 Sep 2026), in days.
      - name: essay_window
        description: before (-30..-1), after (+1..+30), essay_day (0) or outside.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [before, after, essay_day, outside]
      - name: essay_period
        description: >
          Signed 10-day period of days_from_essay, three per window: -3 = days 21..30 before,
          -1 = days 1..10 before, +1 = days 1..10 after, +3 = days 21..30 after. Rows outside
          the windows fall beyond +/-3.
      - name: essay_period_label
        description: Readable label for essay_period, for example "1-10 days after" or "21-30 days before".
      - name: release_weekday
        description: Day of the week of release_date.
      - name: is_weekend
        description: Released on a Saturday or Sunday.
      - name: is_counted
        description: Meets the inclusion rules (METHODOLOGY 4.2). The main definition.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: exclusion_category
        description: For excluded rows, the METHODOLOGY 4.3 category; null for counted rows.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [lab_outside_list, outside_window, roadmap_mention, never_released, decision_only_endpoint, product_configuration, serving_or_pricing_tier, non_llm_modality]
      - name: is_borderline_lab
        description: Developer is one of the four borderline labs.
      - name: is_counted_released_only
        description: Main definition minus announced-only models (METHODOLOGY 7.2).
      - name: is_counted_incl_borderline
        description: Main definition plus the borderline labs' in-window releases (METHODOLOGY 7.2).
      - name: has_date_conflict
        description: Credible sources disagree on the date (METHODOLOGY 7.1).
      - name: alt_release_date
        description: The conflicting date where one exists, otherwise release_date.
      - name: days_from_essay_alt_date
        description: alt_release_date minus the essay date.
      - name: essay_window_alt_date
        description: Window under the conflicting dates (the METHODOLOGY 7.1 worst case).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [before, after, essay_day, outside]
      - name: is_window_date_sensitive
        description: The conflicting date would move the row to a different window.
      - name: source_url
        description: Main supporting source.
      - name: source_domain
        description: Host of source_url.
      - name: source_type
        description: vendor, tracker, press or aggregator (METHODOLOGY 5).
      - name: source_rank
        description: 1 vendor, 2 tracker, 3 press, 4 aggregator.
      - name: notes
        description: Research notes as written.

  - name: metricflow_time_spine
    description: Day-grain calendar for 2026, required by MetricFlow.
    time_spine:
      standard_granularity_column: date_day
    columns:
      - name: date_day
        granularity: day
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

  - name: rpt_release_gaps
    description: >
      One row per pair of consecutive days with at least one counted release. gap_position
      says whether the gap sits inside a window or spans the essay date.
    columns:
      - name: gap_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: gap_start_date
        description: Previous day with a counted release.
      - name: gap_end_date
        description: Day with a counted release.
      - name: gap_days
        description: Days between the two release days.
      - name: quiet_days
        description: Days with no counted release in between (gap_days - 1).
      - name: releases_on_end_date
        description: Counted releases on gap_end_date.
      - name: start_window
        description: Window of gap_start_date.
      - name: end_window
        description: Window of gap_end_date.
      - name: gap_position
        description: within_before, within_after or across_essay.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [within_before, within_after, across_essay]

  - name: rpt_rate_tests
    description: >
      Before vs after counts per segment, with an exact conditional binomial test of equal
      release rates and a Bonferroni correction across all rows. Descriptive statistics on
      small counts, not evidence of cause.
    columns:
      - name: comparison_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: comparison_order
        description: Display order.
      - name: comparison_group
        description: headline, capability, essay_stance, geography, access or sensitivity.
      - name: comparison_label
        description: What the segment counts.
      - name: before_count
        description: Releases in the 30 days before the essay.
      - name: after_count
        description: Releases in the 30 days after the essay.
      - name: change
        description: after_count - before_count.
      - name: rate_ratio
        description: after_count / before_count; null when before_count is 0.
      - name: p_value_two_sided
        description: Exact two-sided p-value of Binomial(before + after, 0.5) at after_count.
      - name: p_value_bonferroni
        description: p_value_two_sided times the number of comparisons, capped at 1.

-- Row-level rules of the enrichment, each written out independently of the model's own
-- CASE logic, plus pins for the handful of rows the date and event rules touch.
with

enriched as (

    select * from {{ ref('int_release_candidates__enriched') }}

),

staged_rows as (

    select count(*) as n from {{ ref('stg_research__release_candidates') }}

),

expected_alt_windows as (

    -- METHODOLOGY 7.1: the window each date-conflict row lands in under its conflicting date.
    select * from (values
        ('DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813', 'outside'),
        ('Kimi K2.8 Preview', 'essay_day'),
        ('Grok 4.6', 'outside'),
        ('Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash', 'after')
    ) as t (model_name, expected_window)

),

expected_events as (

    select * from (values
        ('GPT-6.1 Sol', 'OpenAI DevDay'),
        ('Qwen4 family (Max, Plus, Flash, 27B)', 'Alibaba Apsara Conference')
    ) as t (model_name, expected_event)

),

failures as (

    select 'joins dropped or duplicated rows' as failure, null as release_id
    from enriched
    having count(*) <> (select n from staged_rows)

    union all

    select 'essay_period is not the signed 10-day bucket of days_from_essay', release_id
    from enriched
    where essay_period <> sign(days_from_essay) * ceil(abs(days_from_essay) / 10.0)

    union all

    select 'top_tier_kind disagrees with is_top_tier and is_snapshot_update', release_id
    from enriched
    where (top_tier_kind = 'flagship_refresh') <> coalesce(is_top_tier and is_snapshot_update, false)
        or (top_tier_kind = 'new_flagship') <> coalesce(is_top_tier and not is_snapshot_update, false)
        or (top_tier_kind = 'below_flagship') <> coalesce(not is_top_tier, false)

    union all

    select 'exclusion_category set on a counted row, or missing on an excluded one', release_id
    from enriched
    where (is_counted and exclusion_category is not null)
        or (not is_counted and (exclusion_category is null or exclusion_category = 'unclassified'))

    union all

    select 'outside_window exclusion on a row inside a window', release_id
    from enriched
    where exclusion_category = 'outside_window' and essay_window <> 'outside'

    union all

    select 'alternative window differs without a date conflict', release_id
    from enriched
    where not has_date_conflict and essay_window_alt_date <> essay_window

    union all

    select 'date-conflict row lands in the wrong alternative window', enriched.release_id
    from expected_alt_windows
    left join enriched
        on expected_alt_windows.model_name = enriched.model_name
    where enriched.essay_window_alt_date is distinct from expected_alt_windows.expected_window

    union all

    select 'launch_event does not match the rows whose notes name an event', coalesce(enriched.release_id, expected_events.model_name)
    from enriched
    full outer join expected_events
        on enriched.model_name = expected_events.model_name
    where enriched.launch_event is distinct from expected_events.expected_event

)

select * from failures

-- Pins the exact test to values worked by hand, so a broken implementation cannot pass.
--   15 vs 14: the after count sits at the centre of Binomial(29, 0.5), so p = 1.
--   10 vs 3: lower tail P(X <= 3 | n = 13) = (1 + 13 + 78 + 286) / 8192, doubled = 0.09228515625.
--   2 vs 7: upper tail P(X >= 7 | n = 9) = (36 + 9 + 1) / 512, doubled = 0.1796875.
--   0 vs 1: no before releases, so the rate ratio is undefined (null) and p = 1.
--   13 vs 14: the worst-case dates variant reads essay_window_alt_date, not essay_window.
with

expected as (

    select * from (values
        ('all_counted', 15, 14, 0.933, 1.0),
        ('region_china', 10, 3, 0.3, 0.09228515625),
        ('author_or_endorser', 2, 7, 3.5, 0.1796875),
        ('region_europe', 0, 1, null, 1.0),
        ('worst_case_dates', 13, 14, 1.077, 1.0)
    ) as t (comparison_id, before_count, after_count, rate_ratio, p_value_two_sided)

)

select
    expected.comparison_id,
    expected.p_value_two_sided as expected_p,
    tests.p_value_two_sided as actual_p,
    expected.rate_ratio as expected_ratio,
    tests.rate_ratio as actual_ratio
from expected
left join {{ ref('rpt_rate_tests') }} as tests
    on expected.comparison_id = tests.comparison_id
where tests.comparison_id is null
    or tests.before_count <> expected.before_count
    or tests.after_count <> expected.after_count
    or tests.rate_ratio is distinct from expected.rate_ratio
    or abs(tests.p_value_two_sided - expected.p_value_two_sided) > 1e-9
    or tests.p_value_two_sided not between 0 and 1
    or tests.p_value_bonferroni < tests.p_value_two_sided

-- Cadence report: one gap per consecutive pair of counted release days, gap positions
-- consistent with their windows, and the single gap that spans the essay pinned.
with

gaps as (

    select * from {{ ref('rpt_release_gaps') }}

),

release_days as (

    select count(distinct release_date) as n
    from {{ ref('fct_release_candidates') }}
    where is_counted

),

failures as (

    select 'gap count is not counted release days minus one' as failure, null as gap_id
    from gaps
    having count(*) <> (select n - 1 from release_days)

    union all

    select 'gap_position disagrees with the windows of its endpoints', gap_id
    from gaps
    where (gap_position = 'within_before' and (start_window <> 'before' or end_window <> 'before'))
        or (gap_position = 'within_after' and (start_window <> 'after' or end_window <> 'after'))
        or (gap_position = 'across_essay' and (start_window <> 'before' or end_window <> 'after'))

    union all

    select 'the gap across the essay is not 11 Sep to 18 Sep (7 days)', null
    from gaps
    where gap_position = 'across_essay'
    having count(*) <> 1
        or min(gap_start_date) <> date '2026-09-11'
        or min(gap_end_date) <> date '2026-09-18'
        or min(gap_days) <> 7

)

select * from failures
